name: mendwell-pharmacy.household.list
description: List the people this account can act for: the account holder, minors they are guardian of, and patients who gave them a view or refill grant now in force, each with name, relation to the account holder, whether a minor, and the account's patient-wide powers for that person (self, guardian, view, refill, and pickup only for a patient-wide pickup grant). Pickup-only access is not listed here; those fills appear in fills.list, and fill-limited pickup grants in grants.list. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.grants.list
description: List access grants: every grant of a patient the account holder is, or is guardian of, and every grant naming the account holder as grantee, each with scope (view, refill or pickup), optional single fill, expiry and state at the App's current time; plus the account holder's own user confirmations for those grants or patients and whether each is active, used or expired. Optional patient_id filter. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.cards.list
description: List the account holder's own payment cards, masked: label, last four digits and expiry. Whether a card is accepted is known only when it is used. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.stores.list
description: List the chain's stores with address, weekly opening hours (America/New_York), whether each is open at the App's current time and, when drug_id is given, whether it has that drug in stock. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.rx.list
description: List prescriptions of patients the account holder can view (self, wards, view or refill grants): drug, quantity, fills authorized and remaining, written date, expiry (23:59 local on the written date plus 365 days), state, renewals and fill IDs. Optional patient_id. Pickup-only access returns not_authorized. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.rx.get
description: Read one prescription with its prescriber, drug, the drug's label facts with their published sources, renewals and fill IDs. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.list
description: List fills visible to the account holder, with states as of the App's current time (due reviews, resubmissions, pickup warnings and returns are shown as they stand now). Patient, guardian, view or refill access gets the full view; pickup-only access gets a logistics view (store, state, amount due, ready and return times, own prepayment and confirmations). Filters: state, and patient_id or rx_id, which need view access. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.get
description: Read one fill: claim (paid or rejected, reason, eligible date, waived reasons), cash price, prepayment, counter charge, intended collector, hold and pharmacist notes, plan request, due times (review, resubmission, pickup warning, return to stock), timeline, refused collections, cancellation and the account holder's own confirmations for it. Pickup-only access gets the logistics view. No side effects.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.grants.change.preview
description: Preview granting view, refill or pickup access (pickup optionally for one fill; optional expiry) for a patient the account holder is, or is guardian of (action grant with patient_id, grantee_id, scope and optional fill_id and expires_at), or revoking a grant (action revoke with grant_id only). Returns a token, the person who must confirm and the grant before and after. Stores nothing. Confirming needs a user confirmation from that person naming the token.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.grants.change.confirm
description: Apply a previewed grant change: restate the preview's arguments and pass its token. Needs a user confirmation for that token from the required person, used within 30 minutes (confirmation_required, confirmation_invalid); arguments or state that no longer reproduce the token return stale_preview.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.choose_cash.preview
description: Preview paying the chain's cash price instead of the drug plan for a fill whose claim was rejected: the price, the store, the resulting state (ready, or waiting_stock when the store has no stock) and whether a scheduled resubmission is cleared. Stores nothing; on_hold while the fill is held.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.choose_cash.confirm
description: Switch a rejected fill to the cash price with the preview's token; no user confirmation is needed. Returns stale_preview when the price, store, resulting state or resubmission no longer match.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.prepay.preview
description: Preview prepaying a ready, unheld fill's amount due with one of the account holder's own cards. Allowed for a positive amount due with no live prepayment. Returns a token, the person who must confirm (the card owner) and the amount. Stores nothing.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.prepay.confirm
description: Authorize the card for exactly the amount due with the preview's token, after a user confirmation from the card owner used within 30 minutes. A declined or expired card returns payment_failed and nothing is stored. The authorization is captured at collection, or voided on cancellation or return to stock.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.cancel.preview
description: Preview cancelling a fill that is not collected, returned to stock or cancelled: lists the paid-claim reversal, prepayment void, plan-request withdrawal and every timer the cancellation clears. Fills remaining on the prescription are unchanged. Stores nothing.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.cancel.confirm
description: Cancel the fill with the preview's token; no user confirmation is needed. Returns stale_preview when the listed changes no longer match.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.request
description: Request a fill of a prescription at a store in a quantity the drug comes in. Needs refill authority (patient, guardian or refill grant); the prescription must be valid with fills remaining and no active fill. Pharmacist review completes 2 hours after the request, or 2 hours after the store next opens when it is closed; the plan claim is then paid (ready, or waiting_stock without stock) or rejected with a reason.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.change_quantity
description: Change the quantity of a requested fill, or of a fill rejected for quantity_limit, which resubmits the claim. on_hold while held, request_pending while a plan request is pending, quantity_not_allowed for a quantity the drug does not come in.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.change_store
description: Move a fill to another store, keeping its claim, plan request and due times. A waiting_stock fill becomes ready at a store with stock (store_unavailable without). Allowed while requested, waiting_stock, claim_rejected or pending_plan_decision; on_hold while held; invalid_state for a ready or finished fill.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.wait
description: For a claim rejected as refill_too_soon, schedule one automatic resubmission at 00:00 local time on the eligible date, or at once if that has passed. It is cleared when the fill leaves claim_rejected; if the claim is rejected again, no further automatic attempt is made.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.fills.set_collector
description: Record who intends to collect a fill (the patient, a guardian or someone with a pickup grant covering it), or clear it with null. Informational only: the counter checks authority at collection. Cleared when the pickup grant it relied on ends.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.plan_requests.create
description: Ask the pharmacy to request an early-refill override (refill_too_soon) or prior authorization (prior_auth_required) from the prescriber and plan for a rejected fill. The decision arrives later; approval waives that reason and resubmits the claim once.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.plan_requests.withdraw
description: Withdraw a pending plan request; the fill returns to claim_rejected and a later decision is ignored.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.renewals.create
description: Ask the prescriber to renew a prescription that has no fills left or has expired. The reply arrives later; approval creates a new prescription that supersedes this one. One pending renewal per prescription.

name: mendwell-pharmacy.renewals.withdraw
description: Withdraw a pending renewal; a later reply is ignored.
